zh.explain: 在家和在外的谋求都必定大吉大利，现在却像无暇宝玉一样藏在石中。如果遇到贵人指引，那时定会升官发财，风光无限。
divination: 像石头中埋藏的宝玉，须有贵人来发现，才能获得称心如意的地位和重视。
zh.summary: 此卦石藏珍宝之象。所祈求之事能称心如意，非常吉祥。

verse: Plans and schemes are faring well.
Like rare jade concealed in a stone,
If led by a man of wealth and power,
You will receive jewels and treasures.
interpretation: Like jade hidden in a stone, someone will guide you to fulfill your destiny.
You will be happy and delighted.
meaning: Gems hidden in the stones, everything is auspicious and according to your heart’s desires.
en.explain: Everything is thriving for you, be it at home or outside, like a flawless gem embedded in a rock. If you receive guidance from a benefactor, you will definitely enjoy higher status, make a fortune and shine with infinite beauty.
divination: You are like a precious jade buried in the stone, a benefactor needs to discover you, so you can gain the status and recognition according to your wishes.
items: Need to put in some efforts.
Use your talents to your best ability
Study progress to the next level

notes: jieyue 得祇称心: glyph read as 祇 (could be intended 祗; no bottom dot visible at zoom). zh item 寻失物 is printed with a semicolon (寻失物；还在) instead of a colon; key/value split anyway. zh explain prints 无暇 (for 无瑕; the poem uses 瑕), kept as printed. Extra item 迁徙搬家; zh key 畜养动物; en key printed 'Migrating/move house' (not 'Migrating and moving house'); en key 'Traveller'.
